input_authorities: SymbolRecord stable_symbol_id, version_cid, semantic_index_schema, and extractor_version
invariants: The capsule constructor accepts only the closed semantic-capsule schema and compiler version, binds stable symbol identity, version CID, semantic-index schema, extractor version, source/fact CIDs, and relevant binding projection CID into its identity payload, then derives capsule_cid from that canonical structured payload.

Batch compilation sorts symbols by stable ID, rejects duplicate symbols and invalid edge values, and produces a sorted capsule index with canonical DAG-JSON blocks whose claimed CIDs are recomputed before return.
Single-symbol and batch compilation use the same authoritative construction path.
Cold and verified-incremental compilation with identical inputs is byte-identical; prior blocks are reusable only after complete re-verification and byte equality.
Dependency entries bind stable IDs, version CIDs, fact CIDs, and link IDs; a capsule never uses other capsule or symbol-node CIDs as dependencies.
Confidence is monotonic toward less certainty only; heuristic/model-summary metadata is excluded and cannot raise semantic confidence or become evidence.
Result verification rejects missing, noncanonical, CID-mismatched, or record-mismatched blocks and verifies the capsule index as well.
